system.description:
Soldier-ascetics who fight in the field behind spear and shield, trading a little speed for a lot of staying power.

  • Spear Discipline: Stun Attack and Deflect work with a spear, staff or polearm you wield, as if unarmed.
    • 9th level: while you carry a shield, Deflect can also turn a melee attack against an adjacent ally.
  • Armoured Discipline: you are trained in light armour and shields, and keep Fast Movement and Deflect in light armour. Your AC is 10 + the armour's bonus + your shield's bonus + half the Monk table's AC bonus (table AC minus 10, rounded down); Dexterity does not add.
